description: Election Commission - S. Moupiya  was elected as a member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council due to non-attendance of meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new council member, which falls under the Elections category.
